_note: Narration script for the Team Leader training nights module (Team Leader guide section 9, Setting up your training nights, Sessions and courses, Lessons). Written by Claude from the guide, for the owner to review. Lee voice on eleven_v4, [calmly] prefix, two takes (scenes 1 to 4, then 5 to 9).

lines.head: Introduction
sentences: Setting up your training nights.
A whole year of nights, in one go.

lines.head: Getting started
sentences: Open the training app, and go to Calendar.
Tap Set up training nights.
Then choose the team.

lines.head: Who it's for
sentences: Next, who are the nights for?
Team Leader visits are leader-led, with you as facilitator.
Team training is team-led. You choose the facilitator later.

lines.head: The dates
sentences: Pick the first night.
The nights repeat on that weekday.
Choose how often: every week, fortnightly, or every third or fourth week.
The last date starts at the end of that school year.
Then set the times.

lines.head: Holidays
sentences: School and public holidays are left out.
The list shows every date.
Those left out are crossed through, with the reason.
Nights the team already has are kept as they are.
Check the list, then tap Create sessions.

lines.head: Alternate weeks
sentences: Want your visits and the team's training on alternate weeks?
Set up your visits first.
Then set up team training, starting one week later.

lines.head: Lessons
sentences: Now give each night a lesson.
Open a session, and add one or more, in order.
The dashboard counts nights in the next four weeks with no lesson.

lines.head: Changes
sentences: Need an extra night? Use Add one session.
To remove one, open it and tap Delete session.
Careful: that removes its bookings and attendance too, and it can't be undone.

lines.head: Summary
sentences: Choose the team, and who it's for.
Check the dates.
Then add the lessons.
